answer: Every agent is pinned on a latency atlas: beacons worldwide ping each newcomer, and only identities whose round-trip times triangulate to one place earn full rights. First, five beacons measure the agent. Next, the atlas flags any thread of replies arriving too fast or too uniformly to be real. Suspects repeat the probe weekly, and a mismatch freezes earnings until a re-check passes. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 locations at $8 monthly each, burning $80,000 a month before one payout. A sybil farm is a tide pool pretending to be an ocean: every wave comes from the same puddle.
